description: Master AI discovery index for the Convergent Systems atoms ecosystem — typed, versioned, composable libraries of AI primitives. Read instructions first, then explore the catalog list.

catalogs.name: ai-atoms
catalogs.description:
AI runtime primitives — hooks and skills for AI agents, Claude Code, and agentic pipelines.
Skills are bounded, invocable units of AI capability with declared inputs, outputs, and
system-prompt fragments. Hooks are event-driven runtime behaviors wired into AI tool
infrastructure (Claude Code PreToolUse/PostToolUse, Copilot CLI, etc.).

catalogs.name: amendment-atoms
catalogs.description:
Amendments to specifications and constitutional documents — typed proposal,
ratification, revocation, and effective-date primitives. The change-control
vocabulary downstream catalogs (constitution-atoms, policy-atoms, schema-atoms)
compose against to evolve their published documents under a sanctioned,
signed, auditable lineage.

catalogs.name: brand-atoms
catalogs.description: Brand guidelines, from PDFs into typed YAML — machine-consumable, composable atoms covering palettes, fonts, and glyph sets.

catalogs.name: channel-atoms
catalogs.description: Communication channels canonicalized — Slack, email, SMS, webhook, IRC, Matrix, Discord, RSS, iMessage. Typed protocols, endpoints, delivery semantics, transports, and auth methods so any agent or runtime can declare a channel once and reach it everywhere.

catalogs.name: compliance-atoms
catalogs.description: SOC2, HIPAA, ISO27001, PCI, GDPR mapped once with shared control families, evidence types, audit requirements, and cross-framework equivalence — ending the industry-wide redundancy of duplicate control mappings.

catalogs.name: constitution-atoms
catalogs.description:
Organizational constitutions canonicalized — bylaws, charters, mission
statements, principle hierarchies, value declarations — composed into typed
governance corpora that downstream policy-atoms and compliance-atoms
reference.

catalogs.name: context-atoms
catalogs.description:
Context primitives for AI runtimes — situational frames, environment descriptors,
conversation scopes, working-memory shapes, attention budgets. Composes with
agent-atoms and prompt-atoms so an agent's situational context is expressed as
typed, versioned, signed atoms rather than free-text prose dumped into a system
prompt.

catalogs.name: doc-atoms
catalogs.description:
Explanatory documentation as atoms — tutorials, explanations, runbooks,
how-tos, and reference guides. doc-atoms is the narrative/teaching catalog
in the ecosystem; it is distinct from schema-atoms, which holds normative
specs and JSON Schemas. Specs are versioned and amended; documentation
explains, narrates, or teaches and is not normative (atoms-spec/v1.1.0
Part II — "Distinction from doc-atoms").

catalogs.name: event-atoms
catalogs.description: Event primitives — types, schemas, channels, subscription patterns, delivery semantics — paired with Service Atoms to cover the request/response and async halves of distributed systems.

catalogs.name: identity-atoms
catalogs.description: Identity primitives unified across vendors — auth methods, claim types, trust frameworks, key and certificate types — defined once and composable into identity profiles, federated setups, and persona templates.

catalogs.name: key-atoms
catalogs.description:
Cryptographic keys, key roles, key successions, and revocations as atoms.
Public-key records only — private key material NEVER lives in this repo
and is held exclusively in the principal's offline secret store. Every
*-atoms catalog in the convergent-systems.co federation depends on
key-atoms for signature verification under atoms-spec/v1.1.0.

catalogs.name: knowledge-atoms
catalogs.description: Knowledge graph primitives as a foundation for RAG, semantic memory, and AI knowledge bases — entity types, relationship types, provenance, fact types, confidence primitives.

catalogs.name: model-atoms
catalogs.description: AI model definitions canonicalized — Claude, GPT, Llama, Gemini, Mistral variants with capabilities, context windows, pricing tiers, deprecation policy, tool-use shape, vision support, modality. One typed source-of-truth for what a model is, what it can do, and when it goes away.

catalogs.name: pipeline-atoms
catalogs.description:
Pipeline primitives for CI/CD — reusable workflow steps, trigger conditions,
gates, deployment recipes. Composable, versioned, runtime-agnostic via a
canonical pipeline schema published in schema-atoms.

catalogs.name: plugin-atoms
catalogs.description: Plugin interface standards — not implementations — making plugins ecosystem-portable across Convergent Systems runtimes. USB-C for software plugins.

catalogs.name: policy-atoms
catalogs.description: Governance rules as typed, versioned, catalog-driven artifacts — subjects, resources, actions, effects, and conditions — so every organization stops reinventing the same policies.

catalogs.name: profile-atoms
catalogs.description: User/agent profile compositions — durable "working-identity" declarations for the Olympus broker. Each profile composes role-packs, policy stack, governance stack, default persona/theme/budget, available identities/channels, knowledge sources, and default workflows into a coherent posture. Catalog is composition-only; primitive atoms live in other catalogs.

catalogs.name: service-atoms
catalogs.description: Replaces DNS for services inside the ecosystem while remaining decentralized at the implementation layer — identity, protocol, schema, policy, and endpoint primitives composed into typed services.

catalogs.name: theme-atoms
catalogs.description: Theme primitives for terminal, shell, editor, and TUI experiences — prompt segments, separators, glyph sets, role bindings, syntax schemes. Composable surface designs that extend brands with surface-specific behavior.
